note: Airport terminal hall (B21 Aéroport), camera inside the landside entrance facing north to the glass wall and runway. Feminine LEFT: vintage biplane with goose pilot (aviation), woman pressing her red suitcase shut (valise), vet driving the shuttle cart (navette). Centre: rebel pigeon at the bell (rebelle, m/f). Masculine RIGHT: stork at the security arch (aéroport), garage-shaped luggage trolley (bagage), juggling pilot (pilote), conveyor with train suitcase and cat (transit), kangaroo with bone on the bench (bond). Exits: tall open entrance door far left -> B21_aeroport; open glazed doors in the back glass wall -> the apron R_airport_z1. Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08 part 2).
